hypotheses.description: Ordered by likelihood, most likely first. At least two, so the conversation never anchors the human on a single explanation.

summary.description: What might be the root cause, in one or two plain sentences.

evidence.description: Facts readable from the repository that support this hypothesis. Never speculation, and never something only the human could know.

discriminating_question.description: The question that would confirm or rule this out -- something the human knows and the repository does not say. The division of labor is the whole point: never ask what you could have read.

suggested_exit.description: Which exit this hypothesis points at. A suggestion about ordering only; it can never select an exit. Only a literal human choice does that.
